methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Blitzpanel is a pre-seed stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Caleb Ho. The relevant comparison universe consists of 10 peers in the Robotics & Manufacturing sector, including 1 public company (277810.KQ) and 8 private firms. Leading private comparables include Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics.

The peer-median triangulation method is not applicable to this valuation. While 10 same-sector peers exist, the company's pre-seed stage and early-market position create an insufficient narrow peer set—filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables yielded fewer than three datapoints. Relying on the all-sector median would conflate meaningfully different risk profiles and development trajectories, producing misleading guidance.

Without a sufficiently dense peer cohort at the pre-seed stage in this sector, conventional comparable-company analysis cannot be reliably applied. A credible valuation range for Blitzpanel would require alternative methods such as venture-capital method modeling, founder track record assessment, or market-sizing bottom-up analysis—none of which are supported by the data provided. The company's early stage and the sector's relative illiquidity at pre-seed levels remain the primary valuation constraints.
